Intro: Foul prey. I return to sate myself from your ashes and fallen comrades, those broken tears you spill. You can reap, you can weep…
But I can feel you heaving on my thousands of hairs' worth on skin. What do you do, instead? I know what. You are weak.
You think you fight this hell, exile all who defy even one look at you, but the people have changed. I have changed. Here is what is going to happen:
Serve me [DISH], until you understand this world's sour taste, until there is nothing but me hacked in your mind. Feel my teeth, young tender.
Success: Adaptable, aren't you? I'll let you gather your thoughts. You are a great game in this grey jungle.
Fail: An attempt is still an attempt. I give you my honors, delectable one, for you have only failed yourself.
Reject: The deer may outrun the eagle, but where does it go? Straight towards the highway. Look ahead, or else you'll be blinded by the headlights.
